snippet.title: VR After Dark: ItazuraVR (SFW) | THIS IS THE NEXT STEP???
snippet.description:
Join the Pack! ➤ https://bit.ly/2C8V0mE

I've always laughed when these games appeared on Steam as I was browsing new VR games. Well. Today I took the plunge and decided to see what all the hubub was about. Welcome to VR After Dark. Things got awkward. And fast. This is the next step in VR??

ItazuraVR: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1047160/ItazuraVR_Safe_for_Work/

#awolfinvr #virtualreality #itazuravr
